services.title: Interview confidence coaching
services.description: A focused one-to-one session covering behavioural questions, confident delivery and practical feedback for your next interview.

services.title: Behavioural interview deep-dive
services.description: Two hours working through the STAR method on your real examples, with a scored practice round and written notes to take away.

services.title: Resume and cover letter review
services.description: Detailed, actionable feedback to make your application clearer, more relevant and easier for recruiters to scan.

services.title: Mock technical screening
services.description: A realistic 45-minute recruiter screen for software roles, followed by feedback on answers, signal and red flags.

services.title: Career strategy session for skilled migrants
services.description: Map your overseas experience to the Australian market: target roles, salary bands, licensing, and a 90-day plan.

services.title: 30-day job search plan
services.description: Leave with a written week-by-week plan: applications, networking targets, and follow-up cadence.

services.title: LinkedIn profile makeover
services.description: Headline, About section and experience rewritten for search and recruiter appeal, done live with you.
